terms.definition: A collection of related web-accessible resources presented through a common digital presence.
A web-delivered software experience primarily enabling interactive tasks, data processing, or workflows.
A change to the website's visual presentation, interaction experience, or structure; its precise scope must be defined.
Reimplementation of some or all website functionality or architecture.
Movement of website assets, content, data, platform, domain, or infrastructure from one environment or structure to another.
Content Management System used to create, manage, and publish digital content.
The organization, labeling, and relationships of information to support understanding and navigation.
A representation of user interactions and decisions across steps toward an intended goal.
A defined user action considered valuable for a specific website objective.
A defined exchange of data or functionality between systems.
An approach to adapting interfaces across varying viewport sizes and device conditions.
The quality of enabling people with diverse abilities and assistive technologies to perceive, operate, and understand an experience.
A controlled method of restoring an earlier working state after a change or release.
A required authorization checkpoint before a specified decision or action proceeds.
